subject: Co-sell technical discovery: EdgeForge cloud listing and integration
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Lam <sophie.lam@edgeforge.ai>
Cc: Amit Rao <amit@edgeforge.ai>
Date: 2026-07-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Co-sell technical discovery: EdgeForge cloud listing and integration

Hi Sophie / Amit,

Thanks again for the time this morning. As discussed, EdgeForge is a priority ISV partner for the upcoming co-sell push on CloudBridge, and we need to triage a short technical discovery so the marketplace listing and co-sell evidence bundle can move to the cert lane. High-level asks from our side:

- Short deployment architecture (VPC, data flow, customer-managed keys)
- Metering approach (metering events for marketplace metering / private offers)
- Any existing SSO/OAuth flows for tenant onboarding
- A list of security/compliance artifacts you can provide for the marketplace binder (SOC2, penetration test summary, etc.)

Can you share a clean diagram and a short spreadsheet of evidence you have? Olga and Ben are looped for technical and GTM requirements respectively.

Proposed next steps:
1) You share an architecture diagram and evidence spreadsheet by Monday 7/20.
2) We'll review and return a list of follow-ups and a template for CloudBridge entitlements.
3) Quick 30m follow-up if any gaps.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Marcus
Principal Partner Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: edgeforge-ask-list.txt (stub)
From: Sophie Lam <sophie.lam@edgeforge.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit Rao <amit@edgeforge.ai>
Date: 2026-07-18T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell technical discovery: EdgeForge cloud listing and integration

Hi Marcus — thanks for the clear list. Attaching an architecture diagram and a draft evidence checklist (first pass). A few quick notes: 

- Architecture: EdgeForge runs as a multi-tenant service inside customer VPCs (optional) or as a managed SaaS. For CloudBridge listing we plan to support private offers (tenant provisioning via CloudBridge seller APIs). Diagram attached.
- Metering: We emit usage events per inference request; can produce a daily aggregated metering file (CSV) or stream to the marketplace via their ingestion API.
- SSO: We currently support SAML and OIDC — can surface a configuration guide.
- Security: We have a SOC2 Type II report and quarterly pen test summaries; can provide redacted copies.

We aim to get the full evidence workbook to you by Monday 7/20. If you need anything sooner, ping Amit.

Best,
Sophie
Head of Partnerships, EdgeForge

Attachments: edgeforge-arch-diagram.png, edgeforge-evidence-draft.xlsx
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Lam <sophie.lam@edgeforge.ai>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Amit Rao <amit@edgeforge.ai>
Date: 2026-07-19T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell technical discovery: EdgeForge cloud listing and integration

Thanks Sophie — this is really helpful. Couple of clarifying items from the internal review: 

- Metering format: CloudBridge prefers a daily CSV with these columns: date, tenant_id, product_sku, request_count, billable_units. Can you confirm you can populate those fields? If not, we can map.
- Private offers: we'll need an automated flow for provisioning when a private offer is accepted. Do you have an existing API for tenant bootstrap? If so, can you share the spec or a Postman collection?
- KV / cache behavior: for cost/latency recommendations we want to know the typical inference token lengths and whether you rely on local KV caches that require sticky routing.

Olga — can you confirm the exact security artifacts CloudBridge requires so Sophie can prioritize? Ben — Ben, please confirm the co-sell collateral we should ask for (POC credits, demo entitlements, joint case studies).

Marcus

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Sophie Lam <sophie.lam@edgeforge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T12:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell technical discovery: EdgeForge cloud listing and integration

Sophie — thanks for the draft. From the marketplace compliance side the minimum evidence set we need for CloudBridge pathing: 

- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted is OK)
- Penetration test summary and remediation notes
- Data retention policy and deletion workflow (for egress/regulatory asks)
- KMS details: whether customer keys (BYOK) are supported or not
- Diagram pointing out any third-party data processors (we need vendor list)
- Sample logs/audit trail (obfuscated tenant ids acceptable) for last 30 days

Two practical asks: please add a one-line description next to each evidence row in the workbook describing the artifact and whether it's downloadable or requires an NDA. That will speed reviews.

On the metering front: If you can commit to the daily CSV with the columns Marcus listed, CloudBridge metering integration will be straightforward. If you prefer streaming, include an example of the payload.

I'll draft the exact request template and share it by EOD so you can slot artifacts into it.

Olga
Security & Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Lam <sophie.lam@edgeforge.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T17:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell technical discovery: EdgeForge cloud listing and integration

Sophie — appreciate the quick turnaround on the materials. A couple of GTM asks to align before we publish: 

- Demo entitlements: can you provide 30 free demo seats per month for co-sell proof-of-concept customers? We typically use these to remove friction for ISVs on CloudBridge.
- Case study: would you be open to a joint customer case study after the first 3 paid customers? We can draft and handle approvals.
- Private offer margin: CloudBridge typically requires a listing margin table; if you can share target discount tiers for co-sell, that helps finance prep.

I attached a short checklist (co-sell-evidence-checklist.xlsx) with the items we'd like to land next. Once we have the artifacts the CloudBridge listing team will kick the cert flow and we should get an initial review in ~10 business days.

If that timeline works, let's schedule the 30m follow-up next week to go through any edge cases (SSO, BYOK, offline metering). Marcus — can you coordinate a slot?

Thanks,
Ben
Director, Partner GTM, Redwood Inference

Attachments: co-sell-evidence-checklist.xlsx
